capability: Corrected EM finite spectra and candidates
Compose EM cases, corrected finite matrices and original-order spectra with bounded numerical evidence.
operation: compute finite rational EM wavevector spectra
inverse: angular frequency to finite-model spectrum
discovery.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
discovery.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
discovery.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits

excluded: No claim that every auxiliary eigenvalue is a kinetic physical mode; no infinite-mode completeness or cross-thread invariance.
preconditions: Declared local Python runtime (Python 3.14, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1); single-threaded BLAS environment.
Declared Python 3.14 runtime with NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy 1.18.1; no external runtime is required.
supported: Two cases, J8/J12, all eight N controls and source79-frequency default.
All finite spectra, original-order values, selection candidates and terminal matrices.

example.description: API-shape example with max_harmonic=0; N=0 does not demonstrate a converged physical spectrum.
example.expected: PASS: the example runs locally and returns the declared output structure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent SI state, genuine nonzero-residue poles, or an unrepresentable spectrum/matrix.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: The EM solve performs no nonlinear search; solve failures are explicit ValueError rather than a convergence flag.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result mapping is returned after an error; a returned EM spectrum carries finite arrays and explicit completeness/selection diagnostics; no status field is promised.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy/SciPy numerical errors propagate with operation context; no native runtime, source checkout or network fallback is selected.

assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

summary: Compose EM cases, corrected finite rational matrices and heuristic candidate spectra with explicit model/evidence ceilings.

title.en: EM finite rational-model spectra with candidate selection
title.zh: EM 有限有理模型谱与候选选取

scope: Independent basis: the returned candidate frequencies are the eigenvalues of the matrix the call itself returns -- det(matM) recomputed at 40 mpmath digits equals the product of the complete spectrum, and every selected candidate coincides with an element of that spectrum.
The declared selection structure is checked as an equality: five candidates per frequency, roots equal to kxx, and each candidate drawn from the spectrum rather than synthesised.
Test matrix: EM case 2 at a fixed frequency, J8, max_harmonic 0.
Failure matrix: one assertion per channel -- a fabricated or displaced candidate set, a matrix that is not the one solved, a wrong candidate count, and a wrong frequency normalisation.
Precision budget, written before measurement: 1e-12 relative on the determinant identity (measured 2.6e-14) and 1e-9 relative for candidate membership in the spectrum.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to EM case 2, J8, max_harmonic 0, at explicit single frequencies. Established by an independent 40-digit determinant identity between the returned matrix and the returned complete spectrum, plus the declared candidate-count and membership relations. Excluded scope: case 1, successful J12, max_harmonic 1..7, execution of the default 79-frequency axis, physical mode identity, and infinite-mode completeness.
known_limitations: The candidate ranking rule beyond membership (the heuristic that picks five of the filtered values) has no independent basis; only membership and count are established.
The spectrum is not shown to be complete: the matrix has 40 eigenvalues and the five candidates are a selection from them.

basis.statement: The returned complete spectrum is checked together with the declared candidate-count and membership relations. Excluded scope: case 1, successful J12, max_harmonic 1..7, execution of the default 79-frequency axis, physical mode identity and infinite-mode completeness.
